necessity.rationale: One bounded original policy-classification node, no external capability.
necessity.baseline: One host agent extracting explicit actions from supplied notes.

decisions.rationale: The full input fits one task and each action has a verifiable source quote.
rejected: Additional workers without a distinct evidence source
decisions.rollback: Add a verifier only if measured extraction errors justify its cost.

lifecycle.infra: Use the current host model with no external capabilities.
lifecycle.post: Extract explicit actions, preserve source quotes and null missing fields; one bounded step.
lifecycle.after: Check exact quotes and fields, record missed cases as candidate lessons; do not send assignments.

flow.goal: Apply original source policy exactly without external actions.
assumptions: Original material is supplied and no external effects are performed.

material.description: Original JSON material and its exact decision policy.

decisions.description: Source-ordered decisions with exact required original fields.

nodes.prompt: Apply the supplied JSON material policy. Return decisions in source order with its exact required fields; never perform external actions.
acceptance: All decisions match original material policy exactly.

criteria.assertion: Every decision equals original source policy in original order.
